## Krystal Biotech to Present at 2026 Cantor Global Healthcare Conference


September 3, 2026


[PDF Version](https://ir.krystalbio.com/node/11476/pdf)


PITTSBURGH, Sept. 03, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[Krystal Biotech, Inc.](https://www.krystalbio.com/) (the “Company”) (NASDAQ: KRYS) today announced that the Company will participate in the 2026 Cantor Global Healthcare Conference on September 10, 2026, in New York. Management will take part in a fireside chat scheduled at 3:55 pm ET and host investor meetings throughout the day.


A webcast of the presentation will be available[here](https://sqps.onstreamsecure.com/origin/enliven/players/EnlivenPlayer.html?customerId=22&eventId=19637687&checkCompany=1&checkEmail=1&checkName=1) beginning at 3:55 pm ET on Thursday, September 10, 2026 and will be posted on the Investors section of the Company’s[website](https://ir.krystalbio.com/events-and-presentations/events) .


**About Krystal Biotech, Inc.**
Krystal Biotech, Inc. (NASDAQ: KRYS) is a fully integrated, commercial-stage, global biotechnology company focused on the discovery, development and commercialization of genetic medicines to treat diseases with high unmet medical needs. VYJUVEK®, the Company’s first commercial product, is the first-ever redosable gene therapy and the first genetic medicine approved in the United States, Europe, and Japan for the treatment of dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa. The Company is rapidly advancing a robust preclinical and clinical pipeline of investigational genetic medicines. Krystal Biotech is headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. Visit[www.krystalbio.com](http://www.krystalbio.com/) to learn more or follow us on[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/krystal-biotech-inc/) and[X](https://x.com/KrystalBiotech) .
